title: Confirming Activate moves the ticked parts back to the Active tab
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT-01 to -03) are inactive at {Location-A}.
  • All three part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  5. Click Activate parts.
  6. Click the {Part-A} row.
  7. Click the {Part-B} row.
  8. Click the Activate button on the bar.
  9. Click Activate in the "Activate parts?" confirmation.
  10. Do not refresh the page.
  11. Click the Active tab.
  12. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 8: The "Activate parts?" confirmation opens, reads "2 parts selected.", and its confirm button is a blue "Activate".
  • Step 9: A green toast reads "2 parts updated." {Part-A} and {Part-B} leave the Inactive list at once, without a page reload, and {Part-C} is still listed. Bulk mode ends and nothing is ticked.
  • Step 12: The Active tab lists {Part-A} and {Part-B}, and not {Part-C}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk); story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S3-R4, S3-R5, S10-R3, S10-R11, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.6 (Inactive tab, Activate parts), board 4.7 (Confirm the reactivation), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R4: “When the user confirms (Story 10), every ticked part becomes active and leaves the Inactive tab without a page reload.”
  • S3-R5: “The reactivated parts appear on the Active tab.”
  • S10-R3: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation is titled "Deactivate parts?" or "Activate parts?". Raised from the part dialog, it is titled "Deactivate part?" or "Activate part?".”
  • S10-R11: “The confirm button reads "Deactivate" in red for a deactivation and "Activate" in blue for a reactivation. Cancel sits to its left.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, every part changed): “"{n} parts updated." ("1 part updated." for one) | Success toast, fades on its own”
